name: inquiry-resolution-plan
schema: v1 rows used expected_s0; the v2 schema replaces it

label_policy.author: designer; the vocabulary and the frozen rows were adopted by the product owner on 2026-09-20 (DEV/CALIBRATION — never a holdout)
label_policy.steps: CLOSES = an authority allowed to close the need; PRECONDITION = must be read before it; CONTEXT = read, never closes. A fallback to the seller is not a step.
label_policy.expected_s0: what the deterministic authority layer should say on snapshot S0 with the gold judgment — the terminal, not the answer
label_policy.pending: PENDING_ADJUDICATION rows carry the proposal and its alternatives and are excluded from every score until the product owner decides

holds: real inquiry id prefixes and the designer's plan labels; no customer or seller text

storage.builder: build.py (stored beside the gold; reads inquiry-need-eval/v1 needs.jsonl + questions.jsonl from the cache)

withdrawn.why: expected_s0 mixed two meanings for listings whose detail page was never read — the immediate next step (ACQUIRABLE, for answers known to be in the page's images) and the final terminal (NEEDS_SELLER, for knowledge the seller never wrote). The first diagnostic run (fence on the S0 oracle) exposed it before the gold was used anywhere.
withdrawn.superseded_by: inquiry-resolution-plan/v3 (via v2, also withdrawn before use)
